trap.label: to-infinitivo
trap.wrong: Officials are expected that they resume talks.
trap.right: Officials are expected to resume talks.
trap.why: Em português “espera-se que eles retomem” leva oração com que. Em inglês, a passiva de expectativa usa to + infinitivo.

mcq.q: “The delay is reported ___ been caused by quotas.”

opts: A plausible explanation is that quotas rose.

fix.wrong: The delay is reported to be cause by quotas.
fix.right: The delay is reported to have been caused by quotas.

fix.wrong: Officials expect to be resumed talks.
fix.right: Officials are expected to resume talks.

fix.wrong: It is reported that the bloc has a dispute last year.
fix.right: It is reported that the bloc had a dispute last year.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com is reported to have: “People report that quotas caused the delay.”
rewrite.answer: The delay is reported to have been caused by quotas.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com are expected to: “People expect that officials will resume talks.”
rewrite.answer: Officials are expected to resume talks.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com is said to: “People say the bloc is divided.”
rewrite.answer: The bloc is said to be divided.
